seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: April, October and November. Driest: June, July and August. Hottest: March (25.8°C average). Coolest: July (23.6°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: Police may ask you for ID. Always carry a colour copy of your passport, including your visa entry stamp. If you live in Congo, also always carry a colour copy of your residency card.
laws.heading: Personal ID
